verdict.rationale: The Data API only reads report data, and its "build custom dashboards" line describes building your own external dashboards from GA data. Nothing shows the API creating or managing GA4's own dashboards, reports or saved explorations. The Admin API covers property settings such as custom dimensions, key events and links, not saved reports or insights, so this is an adjacent building block rather than the capability itself.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create and manage dashboards and saved insights programmatically via the API
